title: Top K Frequent Words
description:
Given a list of words, find the k most frequent ones.

Input format
Line 1: n and k separated by a space.
Line 2: n lowercase words separated by spaces.

Output format
The k most frequent distinct words, one per line, from most to least frequent. Words with the same frequency are ordered alphabetically.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000. 1 <= k <= number of distinct words. Each word has 1 to 20 lowercase letters.
hints: How can you count how often each word occurs?
Use a dictionary of counts, then sort the distinct words by (-count, word).
If two words have equal counts the alphabetical order decides. Sorting by the pair (-count, word) handles both rules in one step.

examples.input:
6 2
the day is sunny the the
examples.explanation: "the" appears 3 times, then every other word appears once; "day" is alphabetically first among those.

examples.input:
7 3
i love code i love java python
examples.explanation: "i" and "love" occur twice (alphabetical order i, love); then the one-count words start with "code".
